fields.name: quota_mb
fields.help: The most each person may store, in MB, counting every version. 0 means no limit.

fields.name: links_enabled
fields.help: Whether files and folders can be shared by link.

fields.name: link_days
fields.help: How many days a new link works. 0 means it does not expire.

fields.name: link_days_max
fields.help: The longest a link may work, in days. 0 means no limit.

fields.name: search_contents
fields.help: Whether search also looks at the text inside files.

fields.name: comments_enabled
fields.help: Whether people can comment on files.
